the biodegradability of alicyclic gasoline constituents is strongly dependent on the number, position, and nature of substituents, and that the biodegradation of these compounds under methanogenic or sulfate-reducing condition is strongly dependent on their chemical structure.

the anaerobic biodegradative pathways of alicyclics are more complex than previously believed, and the pathways are different under sulfate-reducing versus methanogenic conditions.
